datasets.name: BBBC022_U2OS_CellPainting
datasets.attribution: Gustafsdottir SM et al. (2013) Multiplex Cytological Profiling Assay to Measure Diverse Cellular States. PLOS ONE 8:e80999. Distributed by the Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection (BBBC022).
datasets.description: One U-2 OS field of view from the BBBC022 Cell Painting pilot screen, ~80 cells, 5-channel staining. Two slots (DAPI, glycocalyx-WGA) are biologically real; the actin slot also carries the WGA+phalloidin AGP channel. YAP and paxillin slots are substitutions documented per slot. This is the gold reference demo for exercising the glycocalyx extractors against real WGA-lectin signal.
datasets.pixel_size_note: BBBC022 was acquired on an ImageXpress Micro at 20× — native pixel size 0.656 µm/px (Gustafsdottir 2013, Methods). Override in the sidebar if you re-acquire on different optics.
datasets.crop_strategy: No crop — the BBBC022 sample PNG is the page-preview field (8-bit), already at a tractable 696×520 resolution. Full 16-bit TIFFs at native resolution are available inside the BBBC022 plate-channel zip archives.

glycocalyx.note: Real WGA-lectin signal — the canonical glycocalyx marker. Cell Painting bundles WGA with phalloidin in a single AGP channel, so the same image also feeds the actin slot below. Glycocalyx pericellular features are scientifically meaningful on this slot.

yap.note: Real ER stain (concanavalin A), not anti-YAP. The YAP N/C ratio computed on this slot reflects ER nuclear-perinuclear intensity, not YAP/TAZ translocation, and should not be interpreted as mechanotransduction signal.

paxillin.note: Real mitochondrial stain, not anti-paxillin. Focal-adhesion features extracted from this slot reflect mitochondrial puncta morphometry, not adhesion biology.

actin.note: Same AGP channel as the glycocalyx slot — Cell Painting does not separate WGA from phalloidin. Actin coherence and cortical-ratio features therefore reflect a mixture of WGA membrane staining and phalloidin F-actin and should be interpreted with that caveat.

datasets.name: HPA_SDC1_U2OS
datasets.attribution: Human Protein Atlas, SDC1 in U-2 OS (osteosarcoma), antibody 6185/95_B1_1
datasets.description: Syndecan-1 immunofluorescence in U-2 OS cells. SDC1 is the primary heparan-sulfate proteoglycan target for glycocalyx perturbation studies.
datasets.pixel_size_note: Assumed: HPA confocal native ~0.08 µm/px (Leica SP5 60×) downsampled 1728→768 px (×2.25). Override in the sidebar if you have exact metadata.
datasets.crop_strategy: DAPI-dense center crop at native resolution; preserves per-cell pixel size so Cellpose-SAM operates at ~0.88 average precision (Stringer & Pachitariu 2024 benchmark).

glycocalyx.note: Real antibody stain of SDC1. Labouesse protocol expects WGA-lectin in this slot — SDC1 is a glycocalyx target gene, so feature extraction on this slot still exercises the pipeline meaningfully.

yap.note: HPA does not provide a YAP co-stain in this image. The YAP slot is duplicated from the antibody channel so the pipeline runs end-to-end; YAP N/C ratios computed on this image are not biologically meaningful.

paxillin.note: Real endoplasmic reticulum reference, not paxillin. Focal-adhesion features on this image reflect ER punctate structure and should not be interpreted biologically.

actin.note: Real microtubule reference, not phalloidin-stained actin. Actin coherence values reflect microtubule organisation.
